# Kirox

> Recycle .kiro CLI

CLI tool to fetch Kiro specification and steering files from remote GitHub repositories

## Table of Contents

### Guide

- [Guide](/kirox/guide.md): User guide for Kirox CLI
- [Getting Started](/kirox/guide/getting-started.md): Installation and initial setup for Kirox CLI
- [Basic Usage](/kirox/guide/basic-usage.md): Basic commands and options for Kirox CLI
- [Advanced Usage](/kirox/guide/advanced-usage.md): Advanced features and configuration for Kirox CLI
- [Troubleshooting](/kirox/guide/troubleshooting.md): Common issues and solutions

### CLI Reference

- [CLI Reference](/kirox/cli.md): Reference for Kirox CLI commands

- [completion Command](/kirox/cli/completion.md): Shell completion script generation command
